text: I think you'll love Sweetslady's Chocolate Peanut Butter Brownie Trifle! Given your fondness for cookies and brownies, this recipe combines the best of both worlds in a layered dessert. The addition of peanut butter and cream cheese gives it a rich and creamy texture, while the chocolate syrup adds an extra indulgent touch. With its high calorie and sugar content, this treat is sure to satisfy your sweet tooth, and the use of powdered sugar and icing sugar aligns with your preferences.
